title: Closing Horizon and Seasonal Market Days — In-Place Home Resale
content:
**Closing horizon.** For the lowest closing price of an In-Place Home Resale listing, the closing horizon is the package's buyer application deadline plus its closing deadline plus the seasonal market days. On every package the buyer application deadline is 5 calendar days and the closing deadline 30 calendar days, so the horizon is 35 days plus the seasonal market days.

**Seasonal market days.** The seasonal market days follow the community on the seller's Home-Site Lease and the month of the handling date: Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows in one of the package's winterization months (November, December, January, February and March on every package) add 30 days; Willow Bend Estates, Palmetto Shores or Saguaro Vista in one of the summer months May, June, July, August and September (months 5 to 9) add 20 days; any other community or month adds none.

| Community on the Home-Site Lease | Month of the handling date | Seasonal market days | Closing horizon |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | November to March | 30 | 65 days |
| Cedar Hollow or Conestoga Meadows | April to October | 0 | 35 days |
| Willow Bend Estates, Palmetto Shores or Saguaro Vista | May to September | 20 | 55 days |
| Willow Bend Estates, Palmetto Shores or Saguaro Vista | October to April | 0 | 35 days |
| Bluebonnet Ridge | any month | 0 | 35 days |

## Points of reading (hypothetical handling dates)

- A Conestoga Meadows home, handled on 4 February: 65 days.
- A Saguaro Vista home, handled on 31 May: 55 days; handled on 1 October: 35 days.
- A Bluebonnet Ridge home, handled on 15 July: 35 days.
